prompt.project_info: Photorealistic overhead image of a five-print Polaroid collage adapted from the source prompt.
prompt.main_subject: The same clearly adult woman appears in five playful instant photographs, with wavy highlighted brown hair, tan glowing skin, natural dewy makeup, neutral lip, black tank top and gold pendant necklaces.
prompt.composition_elements: Five Polaroid prints scattered and slightly overlapping on a textured cream knit wool blanket, with poses including wink and peace sign, blown kiss, hand on cheek, kissy face and broad laugh; red lipstick kiss marks on blanket.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft overhead ambient daylight for the scene, direct flash within each print, slightly overexposed instant-film look, warm personal nostalgia.
prompt.technical_specs: Top-down overhead composition, sharp Polaroid borders and blanket texture, classic white borders, subtle wear and realistic instant-film grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic top-down composition of five vintage Polaroid prints featuring the same clearly adult woman with wavy highlighted brown hair, tan glowing skin, natural dewy makeup, black tank top and gold pendant necklaces, showing playful wink, peace sign, blown kiss, hand on cheek, kissy face and broad laughter, prints scattered on a textured cream knit blanket with red lipstick kiss marks, soft ambient light, direct-flash overexposure inside prints, warm nostalgic instant-film texture, no text or logos.
